spanish: Hablen a hijos de Israel, diciendo: Esta es la bestia viva que comerán desde todo el animal que sobre la tierra.

findings.issue: «es» is an unmarked supplied copula; זֹאת הַחַיָּה has no verb token.
One definite feminine singular noun is rendered as noun plus adjective; «viva» may add a quality the single noun does not mark separately.

notes: Hablen and comerán are ustedes forms of the 2mp imperative and imperfect.
